text.en:
The Repealing Clause of Presidential Decree No. 729, which reads as follows, is denominated as
"SECTION 10. All Acts, executive orders, ordinances, rules and regulations, or parts thereof, which are
inconsistent with the provisions of this Decree are hereby repealed, amended or modified accordingly."
Section ten of the same Decree is renumbered accordingly as Section eleven.

This Decree shall take effect immediately
Done in the City of Manila, this 22nd day of September in the year of Our Lord, nineteen hundred and
seventy-six.
